entries.task_id: this regulation|establishes|a common regulatory framework on insider dealing
entries.description: This Regulation establishes a common regulatory framework on insider dealing
entries.subject: This Regulation
entries.object: a common regulatory framework on insider dealing

spans.text: This Regulation establishes a common regulatory framework on insider dealing, the unlawful disclosure of inside information and market manipulation (market abuse) as well as measures to prevent market abuse to ensure the integrity of financial markets in the Union and to enhance investor protection and confidence in those markets.

entries.description: This Regulation applies to the following:
entries.subject: This Regulation

spans.text: This Regulation applies to the following:
(a) financial instruments admitted to trading on a regulated market or for which a request for admission to trading on a regulated market has been made;
(b) financial instruments traded on an MTF, admitted to trading on an MTF or for which a request for admission to trading on an MTF has been made;

spans.text: (d) financial instruments not covered by point (a), (b) or (c), the price or value of which depends on or has an effect on the price or value of a financial instrument referred to in those points, including, but not limited to, credit default swaps and contracts for difference.

entries.description: Regulation also applies to behaviour or transactions
entries.subject: Regulation also

spans.text: This Regulation also applies to behaviour or transactions, including bids, relating to the auctioning on an auction platform authorised as a regulated market of emission allowances or other auctioned products based thereon, including when auctioned products are not financial instruments, pursuant to Regulation (EU) No 1031/2010.

spans.text: Without prejudice to any specific provisions referring to bids submitted in the context of an auction, any requirements and prohibitions in this Regulation referring to orders to trade shall apply to such bids.
